 Project: example-project                                    poomsae カタ · dev
poomsae カタ [jobs] runs workflows

A job is a schedule plus an action.
A workflow is a named list of steps jobs can run.
A run records what the executor reports and which version of the job or workflow
it used.
poomsae cron --help shows creation examples.

Cron keys
j/k    move
↵/l    open
/      filter
n/e    new/edit
h/esc  poomsae
r      refresh
1-4    tabs
?      help
q      quit
